=== EMAIL to guest@example.com
Subject: Your link to set a car on primary@example.com's parking permit
Provenance: You received this at guest@example.com because someone shared their visitor parking permit with you by email. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

primary@example.com has given you a link to put a car on their City of Stonnington visitor parking permit (Visitor).

When you arrive, open the link and choose your car. It stays on the permit until the end of the day.

https://p.stonn.org/g/tok

Tip: bookmark this link or add it to your phone's home screen — then next time you can open it in one tap, without hunting for this email. The same link works every time.

Keep this link to yourself. If you were not expecting it, you can ignore this email.

Got a visitor permit of your own? p.stonn is free for City of Stonnington residents — p.stonn.org
